newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sodexho confirms sees profit jump.
newsitem.headline: Sodexho confirms sees profit jump.

text.p: French catering group Sodexho confirmed on Tuesday that it expected a 25 percent rise in its net attributable profit on a constant exchange rate basis for the 1996/97 financial year.
It also confirmed its forecast of a 23 percent rise in net earnings per share for the same financial exercise.

"Under the current state of affairs, I confirm the forecasts I made during a board meeting last December, that on a constant exchange rate basis, (I expect) a net attributable profit of 500 million francs, representing a 25 percent increase over 1995/96," Sodexho chairman Pierre Bellon told the cmpany's annual meeting.
He also indicated that the outlook was favourable over the medium term generally for the company's activities.
For 1995/96, the company reported a 41 percent rise in pre-exceptional profit to 401.2 million francs from 284.4 million the previous year.
